package basispoints

// Runs ONLY in the h22-live tree, next to zz_h25_s2_fixtures_test.go,
// zz_h25_s3_fixtures_test.go and zz_h25_s4_fixtures_test.go copied unchanged:
// records h22's own outputs for the H25 S4 fixtures. Output path from
// S4_GOLDEN_OUT.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

type s4GoldenPrompt struct {
	Body                     string `json:"body"`
	PlainBody                string `json:"plain_body"`
	Instructions             string `json:"instructions"`
	PlainInstructions        string `json:"plain_instructions"`
	Reminder                 string `json:"reminder"`
	NoRelayInstructions      string `json:"no_relay_instructions"`
	NoRelayPlainInstructions string `json:"no_relay_plain_instructions"`
}

type s4GoldenDecode struct {
	OK   bool   `json:"ok"`
	Call string `json:"call"`
}

type s4GoldenStream struct {
	Events   []string `json:"events"`
	CloseErr string   `json:"close_err"`
}

type s4GoldenTransform struct {
	Body   string `json:"body"`
	Status int    `json:"status"`
	Kind   string `json:"kind"`
}

type s4Golden struct {
	Generator  string                       `json:"generator"`
	Prompts    map[string]s4GoldenPrompt    `json:"prompts"`
	Decodes    map[string]s4GoldenDecode    `json:"decodes"`
	Streams    map[string]s4GoldenStream    `json:"streams"`
	Transforms map[string]s4GoldenTransform `json:"transforms"`
	Scenarios  map[string][]s3TurnResult    `json:"scenarios"`
}

func TestGenerateS4Golden(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("S4_GOLDEN_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("S4_GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	golden := s4Golden{Generator: "h22-live " + Version, Prompts: map[string]s4GoldenPrompt{}, Decodes: map[string]s4GoldenDecode{},
		Streams: map[string]s4GoldenStream{}, Transforms: map[string]s4GoldenTransform{}, Scenarios: map[string][]s3TurnResult{}}
	for _, fixture := range s4PromptFixtures() {
		body, err := prepareResponsesBody(cloneObject(fixture.Source), defaultConfig())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		plainCfg := defaultConfig()
		plainCfg.ClientIdentity.PlainPrologue = true
		source := cloneObject(fixture.Source)
		plainBody, err := prepareResponsesBodyFor(source, plainCfg, conversationScope(source), persona{}, identityHygiene)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		withoutTools := cloneObject(fixture.Source)
		delete(withoutTools, "tools")
		golden.Prompts[fixture.Name] = s4GoldenPrompt{
			Body: string(jsonBytes(body)), PlainBody: string(jsonBytes(plainBody)),
			Instructions:             clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, false),
			PlainInstructions:        clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(fixture.Source, true),
			Reminder:                 clientToolProtocolReminder(fixture.Source),
			NoRelayInstructions:      clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(withoutTools, false),
			NoRelayPlainInstructions: clientToolProtocolInstructionsFor(withoutTools, true),
		}
	}
	sources := s4DecodeSources()
	for _, fixture := range s4DecodeFixtures() {
		call, ok := decodeTransportItem(cloneObject(fixture.Native), sources[fixture.Source])
		record := s4GoldenDecode{OK: ok}
		if ok {
			record.Call = string(jsonBytes(call))
		}
		golden.Decodes[fixture.Name] = record
	}
	for _, fixture := range s4StreamFixtures() {
		fixture := fixture
		t.Run(fixture.Name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result := runStreamTest(t, cloneObject(fixture.Request), fixture.Chunks)
			golden.Streams[fixture.Name] = s4GoldenStream{Events: s2NormalizeStream(result.joined()), CloseErr: result.closeErr}
		})
	}
	for _, fixture := range s4TransformFixtures() {
		body, _, _, err := transformResponseBody(jsonBytes(fixture.Response), cloneObject(fixture.Source))
		record := s4GoldenTransform{Body: string(body)}
		var api *APIError
		if errors.As(err, &api) {
			record = s4GoldenTransform{Status: api.Status, Kind: api.Kind}
		} else if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(fixture.Name, err)
		}
		golden.Transforms[fixture.Name] = record
	}
	for _, scenario := range s4Scenarios() {
		golden.Scenarios[scenario.Name] = s3RunScenario(t, scenario, nil)
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(golden, "", " ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("prompts=%d decodes=%d streams=%d transforms=%d scenarios=%d", len(golden.Prompts), len(golden.Decodes), len(golden.Streams), len(golden.Transforms), len(golden.Scenarios))
}
